profile.summary: Marsons Limited engages in manufacturing and selling of power and distribution transformers in India. The company offers distribution, power, dry type, pad mounted, WTG, furnace and inverter duty, liquid-filled power, substation power, generator step-up, and specialty transformers. It also provides after sales services. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kolkata, India.
